disposition: Do not promote the previous-season record feature. Prospect PA RMSE and fixed-yield value RMSE improve slightly, but paired intervals include harm, MAE and appearance scores worsen, four of seven origin PA contrasts worsen, and important readiness misses remain. Preserve the dated source, the completed comparison and the narrower opportunity hypothesis; keep V68/V53/V63 unchanged and resume the practical plan's delivered-value integration comparison.

players.57052: Kurtz, origin 2024: age 21, 50 professional PA (35 A, 15 AA), 10 K, 12 unintentional BB and four HR. Oakland's dated 69-93 record is observed, not target-season information. Current expected PA 10.184 = .06056 x 168.160; coverage 10.568; record 10.259 = .05895 x 174.031, versus 489 actual MLB PA. The unchanged batting rate is -0.063 custom wins/600 and value barely moves .03073 to .03096 versus 5.83778 actual custom batting-plus-replacement value. Refined participation/active support is 0/0. Record's path contributions are -0.0122 logit and -0.789 conditional PA; fixed-record probes .400/.500/.600 yield 10.259/10.259/10.451. Neither weak-team context nor this tiny change repairs elite-new-draftee readiness. Origin-selected peers include Cam Smith (493 future PA), Quero, DeLauter and Emmanuel Rodriguez (zero each); retain the non-arrivals rather than defining the profile only by Kurtz and Smith.

Current .59910 x 358.735 = 214.918 expected PA; coverage 211.005; record .58423 x 350.927 = 205.021, versus 557 actual. Fixed hitting rate .688 yields value .91185 to .86986, versus 1.79595 actual. Fixed-record probes are 204.394/205.587/199.657 PA. Crews subsequently had 132 PA; Montgomery, DeLauter and Mayer zero. A contender still gave Langford a full season: sparse-profile debut/conditional workload estimation remains a much bigger issue than this record feature.

Current .01523 x 130.367 = 1.985 PA; coverage 2.316; record .01573 x 129.313 = 2.035; actual next-year MLB PA/value are zero. Do not explain Judge's rate or full-season miss by pretending those players have his hitting profile. His custom observed value here is not published full WAR.
